findings.title: B12: follow-up blocked because glucometer strips ran out
findings.claim: A required follow-up for B12 could not be done because the ward has no glucometer strips, and nothing in the graph shows it was restocked.

evidence.text: 0300 B12 RBS 2.9mmol/L!! pt sweaty, confused. insulin inf stopped. 50ml D50 IV given 0305. HO (Dr S.) informed, said rpt RBS in 15mins + restart inf at lower rate when >5.

evidence.quote: asked MMW, they have none either. pharmacy closed till 0800
evidence.text: 0330 glucometer strips finished on ward - last one used for B12. asked MMW, they have none either. pharmacy closed till 0800.
0345 B12 more alert, talking. RBS recheck not done (no strips). insulin inf still off.
0730 handover notes: B5 fever settling. B8 2 units done, FBC am. B9 pain ok. B2 BP ok now. quiet night.

findings.cypher:
MATCH (x:Fact {kind:'stock_out'})-[:OUT_OF]->(s:Supply)<-[:NEEDS]-(o:Fact)
WHERE NOT (x)<-[:RESOLVES]-(:Fact) AND NOT (o)<-[:RESOLVES]-(:Fact)
MATCH (x)-[:CITES]->(xl:Line), (o)-[:CITES]->(ol:Line), (o)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Patient)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:ABOUT]-(r:Fact)-[:CITES]->(rl:Line)
  WHERE r.kind IN ['obs_abnormal','symptom'] AND r.topic = o.topic AND r.t <= o.t
RETURN s.name AS supply, p.key AS patient, p.label AS label, p.bed AS bed,
       {id:x.id, quote:x.quote, key:xl.key, text:xl.text, shift:x.shift} AS stockout,
       collect(DISTINCT {id:o.id, quote:o.quote, key:ol.key, text:ol.text, shift:o.shift}) AS blocked,
       collect(DISTINCT {id:r.id, quote:r.quote, key:rl.key, text:rl.text, shift:r.shift}) AS cause
notes: Left out of the handover summary (SL-A01:L26).
